feature_objects.opening.value: Eda says a swollen joint drips onto her drying shelf. She offers a two-coin refundable knife deposit or a six-coin purchase. Bracing needs ordinary sound wood; an offered demonstration may reveal a more exact fitting method.

feature_objects.joint.value: Firsthand joint inspection: the cross-grain swollen stave leaks onto the one Village drying shelf. An ordinary brace can hold it clear while it still seeps; a matching sound-grain insert can seal this particular joint.

missed.shower.value: The shower passed; the craftsman dried his bench. No missed reward is owed.

feature_objects.purchase.value: You paid Eda six native coins for one actual sharp fitting knife from her finite stock. The tool is yours; the money is now hers.

audit_remainder.terms.value: You deliberately opened the additional local project and commission choices. Each invitation, construction, lesson, stocked offer, preparation and challenge still needs its own current terms, means and commitment. This reading grants no person, material, power, payment or obligation.

remainder_home.terms.value: Eda permits one timber rain cover over the outer measuring strip of her real Village fitting-bench site. Two supplied logs, two coins, two stamina and five played minutes build it. The cover permits only the newly offered offcut-trimming job during actual rain; the old dry rack, shelf, recipes and regional weather keep their existing rules. Your own completed cutting and drying observations can support paid measuring research. One separate specialization requires actual recovered conditioning and an ordinary loaded-frame trial.

remainder_home.trim.value: One real Rough wood log was divided into one Wet repair stave and two Green repair offcuts. Your owned sharp fitting knife became its dulled variant and stayed yours. These three counted green pieces account for the timber; none is sound or dry yet. The reusable measuring jig was not supplied.

remainder_home.dry_offcuts.value: Two actual Green repair offcuts from the disclosed local trimming stock dried into two Compatible repair offcuts over six played minutes. No piece was duplicated and no jig or fitting knowledge was awarded.

remainder_home.room_terms.value: I authorize one guest room inside my actually assembled, player-owned field-workshop site at the native Shack. Two staged phases consume two logs, four construction coins, seven played minutes and three stamina; a counted kit is held and returned in finishing. Only the finished room grants one residence claim. A later one-time willing invitation requires a separate real kit, log and two-coin starter purse. No automatic rent, food drain or supply refill is created.

remainder_home.room_frame.value: One supplied Rough wood log and two paid construction coins became the guest-room frame inside your earned Shack field-workshop site. Four played minutes and one stamina were spent. A frame grants no residence slot or resident.

remainder_home.room_finished.value: The second real log and two construction coins finished one guest room at your earned Shack field workshop. Your counted kit was returned once. The completed room grants exactly one unoccupied residence claim; it grants no person, wood, kit, wage or service. No dismantling action is offered, and occupancy must end before any later removal design.

remainder_home.resident_terms.value: Neri is an independent willing local kit binder with her own body, learned operation and finite attention. Meeting her supplies no tool, wage, residence or result. Invite supplies one actual kit, one log and two native coins to her own stock/purse. She independently accepts supported terms, occupies the one room and performs at most one material service. One coin pays her fittings expense; one remains hers. One produced kit may be collected after her actual job. Decline is free; departure ends future offers while retaining her identity and earned property.

remainder_home.invitation.value: I transferred one actual kit, one log and two native coins to Neri's separate stock and purse under her one-stay terms. This is a supplied invitation, not an immediate occupant or finished service. Her own controller must still accept with the completed vacant room, current willingness and living supported body. The supplies are hers; meeting or rendering cannot refill them.

remainder_home.resident_report.value: I met Neri at the real Shack room. Arrival, occupancy, her funded work and collection are separate commitments. Her completed public work is available through its own known collection control; this meeting grants no stock, occupation or wage.

remainder_home.collected.value: Neri transferred the one actual Prepared survey kit produced by her completed paid service. Her returned tool kit, unspent coin, body and previous work remain hers. This kit supports the existing native field preparation, packing, orders and trade; collection cannot repeat.

world.completion.life.entry.value: You chose to connect the existing field, home and association work. People retain their own property, consent and received knowledge. Repair, measurement, learning, crop work and ordinary work remain separate choices; no supplies or past deeds were granted.

remainder.offers.supply.report.value: Ressa owns one loaded-bank job that needs a Prepared survey kit and the association’s one four-coin supply purse. Accept and deliver before her displayed local deadline, or decline freely. No report refresh creates another purse.

feature_society.meeting.value: Hessa keeps a household; Orr repairs locally; Vale is considering bounded teaching. Each has their own means and may refuse. Meeting them accepted no work.

artifact_collection.offer.value: Vela has one empty frame, one amber prism, one blue prism and one fine pin. She offers the frame for three coins and amber prism for four; one real log earns her blue prism. A loose piece has a function before the collection is complete.

world.completion.lens.terms.value: Vela offers her actual loose amber prism through the existing four-coin purchase, a one-coin owner-operated current sample check, or one consenting thirty-supported-minute loan for a separate refundable four-coin deposit. Borrowing grants use and an exact return duty, never ownership. A returned loan refunds that deposit once; a late return closes only her new voluntary lens service.

exchange.meeting.value: Iona visits from a route workshop. A damp blank bends under her clamp. She offers two wooden coins for one sound fitted seal, but asking accepts no order. She can wait ten played minutes before funding her own work.

exchange.declined.value: You declined this order. Iona will use her own stock and purse; no agreement was made.

exchange.return.value: Iona reports that she funded the fitting herself from her purse and stock. No payment or template gift is owed to you; ordinary work and paid instruction remain available.

exchange.pattern.value: Iona taught the template’s counted fittings for two kits after a paid sale. The tool is now yours; this does not grant Tamsin’s practiced control.

exchange.lens_lead.value: Iona points out the paired viewing instrument beside the Village workshop. A visitor beyond its screen sometimes writes back. Looking through it is a separate choice.

glasshouse.main.glasshouse.lead.value: Iona knows a folded-glass doorway used by a caretaker and visiting artisans. A lead is not permission or passage.

glasshouse.main.glasshouse.door.value: You paid for one opening of the folded doorway. The same interior remains when its route is closed.

glasshouse.main.glasshouse.entered.value: You carried your own body and belongings into the Folded Glasshouse. The doorway remains available for return.

glasshouse.main.glasshouse.returned.value: You returned with the same carried inventory. Joss, the bench, stored supplies and prior work remain in the Glasshouse.

lore.warning.sample.value: Completed an actual local notch/shelf sample using my counted kit and effort. The recorded drain state and observation time support a current warning; the sample says nothing certain about future weather.

lore.warning.terms.value: This distinct rain window lasts twenty supported played minutes. Deliver an attributed warning, fund a willing check, inspect yourself, clear the notch or continue ordinary work. Ressa’s old request, purse, kit need and detour provision keep their meanings. Any trial load must be a newly transferred sound stave; Ressa’s independent response finishes before its admission.

world.completion.lens.measurement.value: Performed a four-minute outdoor examination of the current notch sample using Vela’s owner-operated prism. Vela spent her own stamina and earned the one-coin fee; the same prism returned once. The observed width and alignment concern this sample only, not hidden poison, another source or future weather.

world.completion.learning.terms.value: Two native coins pay Eda only when the five-minute lesson completes. The learner holds and returns one compatible offcut and spends one own stamina; Eda spends one own stamina and keeps her Grain matching source. You may learn personally, fund a willing Neri, or keep ordinary log lining. Neri must finish and settle her old service first; sponsorship spends her own remaining attention, two two-minute trips, lesson effort and separate strip effort. It supplies no refill. A later two-minute job consumes one compatible offcut and one own stamina for one measured strip. Neri owns her actual product until she separately hands it over.

world.completion.learning.procedure.value: Completed Eda’s paid five-minute datum demonstration with one actual compatible offcut held and returned. I spent my own stamina; Eda spent hers and retained her own Grain matching source. I learned only the datum procedure. Its exact teacher/source/sample causes are retained separately; it grants no body, mana, stock or exclusive specialization.

world.completion.learning.made.value: Consumed one actual compatible offcut and my own stamina over two played minutes to fit one measured drain strip. Its frozen current sample cause is retained with this actual production. The strip is physical stock; it can supply the compatible notch or cover once.

world.completion.life.measured_line.value: Your actually taught and made measured strip became the inspected notch lining. One stamina and two supported minutes were spent; your held kit returned once. This changed the current drain before the single rain endpoint, without granting Eda's body, method or energy to you.

world.completion.learning.sponsor_offer.value: Offered one actual compatible offcut and two separate instruction coins. Neri decides whether her own remaining attention, four stamina and permitted trips support the lesson and separate strip work. A refusal preserves her old room, tool, wages and first service; only this unchanged new escrow can be withdrawn.

world.completion.learning.account.value: Met the actual Neri and heard her current answer, travel, instruction, product and handover account. This report supplies no hidden purse, stock, source or completed work.

world.completion.learning.collected.value: Neri separately handed over her actual produced measured drain strip. Its exact maker and frozen sample causes were retained. Her datum procedure, body, wages and room remain hers.

remainder.consequences.plot.terms.value: Nell opens one permitted herb bed beside the Village field association. Her association’s saved planting allocation contains one actual seed packet; buy it for two native coins, then spend one coin for water, two stamina and three played minutes planting it. No packet or crop is free from reading this report. Four further supported local played minutes bring an authored inspection of this bed: an observed cold draft then gives six minutes to cover with one log and two stamina over two minutes, harvest early for three Cooking herbs, or leave a one-herb salvage. Covered work yields five herbs once. This is an original local draft, with no claim about the world’s season or offscreen weather.

remainder.consequences.plot.purchase.value: Two actual native coins entered Nell’s purse, and her association’s one counted seed packet moved into your inventory. This purchase creates no herbs or replenished seed supply.

remainder.consequences.plot.planting.value: Your actual packet was planted in the permitted association bed over three played minutes. Nell received one coin for the bed’s measured water; your two stamina were spent. One finite crop now exists. The later local inspection can expose the authored cold draft only while this bed and its supported contact remain actual.

remainder.consequences.plot.warning.value: At this actual planted Village bed, Nell shows you a cold draft through the hedge. This explicitly authored local trigger creates one six-minute supported played-time response window. Covering consumes a real log and two stamina over two minutes for five Cooking herbs; early harvest gives three; deliberate neglect or timeout gives one. All paths end this same crop once. No global season or universal crop death is inferred.

remainder.consequences.plot.result.value: You consumed one separately made Measured drain strip to fit the narrow draft opening on Nell's same warned herb bed using the current measured datum, one stamina and two supported played minutes. The real strip remains in that cover. Its single final harvest added five real Cooking herbs to your native inventory. This original local fit uses one prepared timber piece rather than two offcuts; it is not a universal material bonus. The strip cannot line the drain too, and no second crop or seed packet is created.

world.completion.materials.cover.value: You consumed one separately made Measured drain strip to fit the narrow draft opening on Nell's same warned herb bed using the current measured datum, one stamina and two supported played minutes. The real strip remains in that cover. Its single final harvest added five real Cooking herbs to your native inventory. This original local fit uses one prepared timber piece rather than two offcuts; it is not a universal material bonus. The strip cannot line the drain too, and no second crop or seed packet is created.

remainder_home.permission.value: I permit the traveler to build one cover on my outer measuring strip and do the disclosed new trimming and measuring work here. My existing shelf, recipes, stock and ownership remain separate. Cover payment is two coins only at actual completion.

world.completion.learning.taught_player.value: I completed this paid datum lesson with the actual learner and held demonstration offcut. Two coins entered my own purse. My own source and body stayed mine.

world.completion.learning.taught_neri.value: I completed this paid datum lesson with the actual learner and held demonstration offcut. Two coins entered my own purse. My own source and body stayed mine.

remainder_home.resident_method.value: I learned ordinary kit binding through my earlier local work. I arrive with my own living two-handed body and finite attention, but no timber, kit or purse. I will choose one funded stay and one supported binding job, retain my own tool and unspent wage, and may leave after reserved work ends.

remainder_home.acceptance.value: I choose the one funded stay in the actual completed vacant Shack room. Its unique residence claim now records my occupancy. I own the supplied kit, log and purse. I will decide on my own one supported binding service; arrival produces no material.

remainder_home.service.value: I spent my supplied log, one actual purse coin for fittings, two of my stamina, one attention and five played minutes to make one new Prepared survey kit. My counted tool kit returned exactly once and stays mine. I retain my remaining coin. The new product belongs to me until the disclosed collection transfer; no second service is promised.

world.completion.learning.offer.value: Received one new actual compatible offcut and two separately held lesson coins. I may accept or decline on my own present means. This offer does not replenish my attention or stamina.

world.completion.learning.accept.value: I consented to one funded datum lesson and separate owned strip work after checking my own attention, four stamina, unchanged supplied stock and Eda’s actual permitted site/source. The trips, demonstration and production still need to happen.

world.completion.learning.arrived.value: Spent my own stamina and two played minutes reaching Eda’s actual Village bench. My body and stock moved together; the traveler need not be my controller.

world.completion.learning.procedure.value: Completed Eda’s paid five-minute datum demonstration with one actual compatible offcut held and returned. I spent my own stamina; Eda spent hers and retained her own Grain matching source. I learned only the datum procedure. Its exact teacher/source/sample causes are retained separately; it grants no body, mana, stock or exclusive specialization.

world.completion.learning.made.value: Consumed the actual supplied compatible offcut and my own stamina over two played minutes to fit one measured drain strip. It is my physical product until the separate agreed handover. No traveler source or stock was granted.

world.completion.learning.returned.value: Spent my own stamina and two played minutes returning to my retained room after the new work ended or was released. No stock, attention or lesson was reset.

remainder.offers.supply.source.value: The association allocated its one finite four-coin local-supply purse to my one loaded-bank job.

remainder.offers.supply.expiry.value: The local deadline passed. I recovered any reserved four coins and kept the unmet need; I will spend my one detour effort on the longer route. No unpaid traveler promise is invented.

remainder.offers.supply.detour.value: Spent my one detour-effort provision and one stamina over two minutes to check the longer route. The kit need remains unmet; no new payout or stock appeared.

exchange.self_fit.value: I paid three coins and used my own sound blank, kit and stamina to fit my parcel.

feature_objects.opening.value: Eda says a swollen joint drips onto her drying shelf. She offers a two-coin refundable knife deposit or a six-coin purchase. Bracing needs ordinary sound wood; an offered demonstration may reveal a more exact fitting method.

feature_objects.joint.value: Firsthand joint inspection: the cross-grain swollen stave leaks onto the one Village drying shelf. An ordinary brace can hold it clear while it still seeps; a matching sound-grain insert can seal this particular joint.

missed.shower.value: The shower passed; the craftsman dried his bench. No missed reward is owed.

feature_objects.purchase.value: You paid Eda six native coins for one actual sharp fitting knife from her finite stock. The tool is yours; the money is now hers.

audit_remainder.terms.value: You deliberately opened the additional local project and commission choices. Each invitation, construction, lesson, stocked offer, preparation and challenge still needs its own current terms, means and commitment. This reading grants no person, material, power, payment or obligation.

remainder_home.terms.value: Eda permits one timber rain cover over the outer measuring strip of her real Village fitting-bench site. Two supplied logs, two coins, two stamina and five played minutes build it. The cover permits only the newly offered offcut-trimming job during actual rain; the old dry rack, shelf, recipes and regional weather keep their existing rules. Your own completed cutting and drying observations can support paid measuring research. One separate specialization requires actual recovered conditioning and an ordinary loaded-frame trial.

remainder_home.trim.value: One real Rough wood log was divided into one Wet repair stave and two Green repair offcuts. Your owned sharp fitting knife became its dulled variant and stayed yours. These three counted green pieces account for the timber; none is sound or dry yet. The reusable measuring jig was not supplied.

remainder_home.dry_offcuts.value: Two actual Green repair offcuts from the disclosed local trimming stock dried into two Compatible repair offcuts over six played minutes. No piece was duplicated and no jig or fitting knowledge was awarded.

remainder_home.room_terms.value: I authorize one guest room inside my actually assembled, player-owned field-workshop site at the native Shack. Two staged phases consume two logs, four construction coins, seven played minutes and three stamina; a counted kit is held and returned in finishing. Only the finished room grants one residence claim. A later one-time willing invitation requires a separate real kit, log and two-coin starter purse. No automatic rent, food drain or supply refill is created.

remainder_home.room_frame.value: One supplied Rough wood log and two paid construction coins became the guest-room frame inside your earned Shack field-workshop site. Four played minutes and one stamina were spent. A frame grants no residence slot or resident.

remainder_home.room_finished.value: The second real log and two construction coins finished one guest room at your earned Shack field workshop. Your counted kit was returned once. The completed room grants exactly one unoccupied residence claim; it grants no person, wood, kit, wage or service. No dismantling action is offered, and occupancy must end before any later removal design.

remainder_home.resident_terms.value: Neri is an independent willing local kit binder with her own body, learned operation and finite attention. Meeting her supplies no tool, wage, residence or result. Invite supplies one actual kit, one log and two native coins to her own stock/purse. She independently accepts supported terms, occupies the one room and performs at most one material service. One coin pays her fittings expense; one remains hers. One produced kit may be collected after her actual job. Decline is free; departure ends future offers while retaining her identity and earned property.

remainder_home.invitation.value: I transferred one actual kit, one log and two native coins to Neri's separate stock and purse under her one-stay terms. This is a supplied invitation, not an immediate occupant or finished service. Her own controller must still accept with the completed vacant room, current willingness and living supported body. The supplies are hers; meeting or rendering cannot refill them.

remainder_home.resident_report.value: I met Neri at the real Shack room. Arrival, occupancy, her funded work and collection are separate commitments. Her completed public work is available through its own known collection control; this meeting grants no stock, occupation or wage.

remainder_home.collected.value: Neri transferred the one actual Prepared survey kit produced by her completed paid service. Her returned tool kit, unspent coin, body and previous work remain hers. This kit supports the existing native field preparation, packing, orders and trade; collection cannot repeat.

world.completion.life.entry.value: You chose to connect the existing field, home and association work. People retain their own property, consent and received knowledge. Repair, measurement, learning, crop work and ordinary work remain separate choices; no supplies or past deeds were granted.

remainder.offers.supply.report.value: Ressa owns one loaded-bank job that needs a Prepared survey kit and the association’s one four-coin supply purse. Accept and deliver before her displayed local deadline, or decline freely. No report refresh creates another purse.

feature_society.meeting.value: Hessa keeps a household; Orr repairs locally; Vale is considering bounded teaching. Each has their own means and may refuse. Meeting them accepted no work.

artifact_collection.offer.value: Vela has one empty frame, one amber prism, one blue prism and one fine pin. She offers the frame for three coins and amber prism for four; one real log earns her blue prism. A loose piece has a function before the collection is complete.

world.completion.lens.terms.value: Vela offers her actual loose amber prism through the existing four-coin purchase, a one-coin owner-operated current sample check, or one consenting thirty-supported-minute loan for a separate refundable four-coin deposit. Borrowing grants use and an exact return duty, never ownership. A returned loan refunds that deposit once; a late return closes only her new voluntary lens service.

exchange.meeting.value: Iona visits from a route workshop. A damp blank bends under her clamp. She offers two wooden coins for one sound fitted seal, but asking accepts no order. She can wait ten played minutes before funding her own work.

exchange.declined.value: You declined this order. Iona will use her own stock and purse; no agreement was made.

exchange.return.value: Iona reports that she funded the fitting herself from her purse and stock. No payment or template gift is owed to you; ordinary work and paid instruction remain available.

exchange.pattern.value: Iona taught the template’s counted fittings for two kits after a paid sale. The tool is now yours; this does not grant Tamsin’s practiced control.

exchange.lens_lead.value: Iona points out the paired viewing instrument beside the Village workshop. A visitor beyond its screen sometimes writes back. Looking through it is a separate choice.

glasshouse.main.glasshouse.lead.value: Iona knows a folded-glass doorway used by a caretaker and visiting artisans. A lead is not permission or passage.

glasshouse.main.glasshouse.door.value: You paid for one opening of the folded doorway. The same interior remains when its route is closed.

glasshouse.main.glasshouse.entered.value: You carried your own body and belongings into the Folded Glasshouse. The doorway remains available for return.

glasshouse.main.glasshouse.returned.value: You returned with the same carried inventory. Joss, the bench, stored supplies and prior work remain in the Glasshouse.

lore.warning.sample.value: Completed an actual local notch/shelf sample using my counted kit and effort. The recorded drain state and observation time support a current warning; the sample says nothing certain about future weather.

lore.warning.terms.value: This distinct rain window lasts twenty supported played minutes. Deliver an attributed warning, fund a willing check, inspect yourself, clear the notch or continue ordinary work. Ressa’s old request, purse, kit need and detour provision keep their meanings. Any trial load must be a newly transferred sound stave; Ressa’s independent response finishes before its admission.

world.completion.lens.measurement.value: Performed a four-minute outdoor examination of the current notch sample using Vela’s owner-operated prism. Vela spent her own stamina and earned the one-coin fee; the same prism returned once. The observed width and alignment concern this sample only, not hidden poison, another source or future weather.

world.completion.learning.terms.value: Two native coins pay Eda only when the five-minute lesson completes. The learner holds and returns one compatible offcut and spends one own stamina; Eda spends one own stamina and keeps her Grain matching source. You may learn personally, fund a willing Neri, or keep ordinary log lining. Neri must finish and settle her old service first; sponsorship spends her own remaining attention, two two-minute trips, lesson effort and separate strip effort. It supplies no refill. A later two-minute job consumes one compatible offcut and one own stamina for one measured strip. Neri owns her actual product until she separately hands it over.

world.completion.learning.procedure.value: Completed Eda’s paid five-minute datum demonstration with one actual compatible offcut held and returned. I spent my own stamina; Eda spent hers and retained her own Grain matching source. I learned only the datum procedure. Its exact teacher/source/sample causes are retained separately; it grants no body, mana, stock or exclusive specialization.

world.completion.learning.made.value: Consumed one actual compatible offcut and my own stamina over two played minutes to fit one measured drain strip. Its frozen current sample cause is retained with this actual production. The strip is physical stock; it can supply the compatible notch or cover once.

world.completion.life.measured_line.value: Your actually taught and made measured strip became the inspected notch lining. One stamina and two supported minutes were spent; your held kit returned once. This changed the current drain before the single rain endpoint, without granting Eda's body, method or energy to you.

world.completion.learning.sponsor_offer.value: Offered one actual compatible offcut and two separate instruction coins. Neri decides whether her own remaining attention, four stamina and permitted trips support the lesson and separate strip work. A refusal preserves her old room, tool, wages and first service; only this unchanged new escrow can be withdrawn.

world.completion.learning.account.value: Met the actual Neri and heard her current answer, travel, instruction, product and handover account. This report supplies no hidden purse, stock, source or completed work.

world.completion.learning.collected.value: Neri separately handed over her actual produced measured drain strip. Its exact maker and frozen sample causes were retained. Her datum procedure, body, wages and room remain hers.

remainder.consequences.plot.terms.value: Nell opens one permitted herb bed beside the Village field association. Her association’s saved planting allocation contains one actual seed packet; buy it for two native coins, then spend one coin for water, two stamina and three played minutes planting it. No packet or crop is free from reading this report. Four further supported local played minutes bring an authored inspection of this bed: an observed cold draft then gives six minutes to cover with one log and two stamina over two minutes, harvest early for three Cooking herbs, or leave a one-herb salvage. Covered work yields five herbs once. This is an original local draft, with no claim about the world’s season or offscreen weather.

remainder.consequences.plot.purchase.value: Two actual native coins entered Nell’s purse, and her association’s one counted seed packet moved into your inventory. This purchase creates no herbs or replenished seed supply.

remainder.consequences.plot.planting.value: Your actual packet was planted in the permitted association bed over three played minutes. Nell received one coin for the bed’s measured water; your two stamina were spent. One finite crop now exists. The later local inspection can expose the authored cold draft only while this bed and its supported contact remain actual.

remainder.consequences.plot.warning.value: At this actual planted Village bed, Nell shows you a cold draft through the hedge. This explicitly authored local trigger creates one six-minute supported played-time response window. Covering consumes a real log and two stamina over two minutes for five Cooking herbs; early harvest gives three; deliberate neglect or timeout gives one. All paths end this same crop once. No global season or universal crop death is inferred.

remainder.consequences.plot.result.value: You consumed one separately made Measured drain strip to fit the narrow draft opening on Nell's same warned herb bed using the current measured datum, one stamina and two supported played minutes. The real strip remains in that cover. Its single final harvest added five real Cooking herbs to your native inventory. This original local fit uses one prepared timber piece rather than two offcuts; it is not a universal material bonus. The strip cannot line the drain too, and no second crop or seed packet is created.

world.completion.materials.cover.value: You consumed one separately made Measured drain strip to fit the narrow draft opening on Nell's same warned herb bed using the current measured datum, one stamina and two supported played minutes. This original local fit uses one prepared timber piece rather than two offcuts; it is not a universal material bonus. The strip cannot line the drain too, and no second crop or seed packet is created.

world.completion.learning.taught_player.value: I completed this paid datum lesson with the actual learner and held demonstration offcut. Two coins entered my own purse. My own source and body stayed mine.

world.completion.learning.taught_neri.value: I completed this paid datum lesson with the actual learner and held demonstration offcut. Two coins entered my own purse. My own source and body stayed mine.

world.completion.learning.accept.value: I consented to one funded datum lesson and separate owned strip work after checking my own attention, four stamina, unchanged supplied stock and Eda’s actual permitted site/source. The trips, demonstration and production still need to happen.

feature_objects.joint.value: Firsthand joint inspection: the cross-grain swollen stave leaks onto the one Village drying shelf. An ordinary brace can hold it clear while it still seeps; a matching sound-grain insert can seal this particular joint.

missed.shower.value: The shower passed; the craftsman dried his bench. No missed reward is owed.

feature_objects.purchase.value: You paid Eda six native coins for one actual sharp fitting knife from her finite stock. The tool is yours; the money is now hers.

audit_remainder.terms.value: You deliberately opened the additional local project and commission choices. Each invitation, construction, lesson, stocked offer, preparation and challenge still needs its own current terms, means and commitment. This reading grants no person, material, power, payment or obligation.

remainder_home.terms.value: Eda permits one timber rain cover over the outer measuring strip of her real Village fitting-bench site. Two supplied logs, two coins, two stamina and five played minutes build it. The cover permits only the newly offered offcut-trimming job during actual rain; the old dry rack, shelf, recipes and regional weather keep their existing rules. Your own completed cutting and drying observations can support paid measuring research. One separate specialization requires actual recovered conditioning and an ordinary loaded-frame trial.

remainder_home.trim.value: One real Rough wood log was divided into one Wet repair stave and two Green repair offcuts. Your owned sharp fitting knife became its dulled variant and stayed yours. These three counted green pieces account for the timber; none is sound or dry yet. The reusable measuring jig was not supplied.

remainder_home.dry_offcuts.value: Two actual Green repair offcuts from the disclosed local trimming stock dried into two Compatible repair offcuts over six played minutes. No piece was duplicated and no jig or fitting knowledge was awarded.

remainder_home.room_terms.value: I authorize one guest room inside my actually assembled, player-owned field-workshop site at the native Shack. Two staged phases consume two logs, four construction coins, seven played minutes and three stamina; a counted kit is held and returned in finishing. Only the finished room grants one residence claim. A later one-time willing invitation requires a separate real kit, log and two-coin starter purse. No automatic rent, food drain or supply refill is created.

remainder_home.room_frame.value: One supplied Rough wood log and two paid construction coins became the guest-room frame inside your earned Shack field-workshop site. Four played minutes and one stamina were spent. A frame grants no residence slot or resident.

remainder_home.room_finished.value: The second real log and two construction coins finished one guest room at your earned Shack field workshop. Your counted kit was returned once. The completed room grants exactly one unoccupied residence claim; it grants no person, wood, kit, wage or service. No dismantling action is offered, and occupancy must end before any later removal design.

remainder_home.resident_terms.value: Neri is an independent willing local kit binder with her own body, learned operation and finite attention. Meeting her supplies no tool, wage, residence or result. Invite supplies one actual kit, one log and two native coins to her own stock/purse. She independently accepts supported terms, occupies the one room and performs at most one material service. One coin pays her fittings expense; one remains hers. One produced kit may be collected after her actual job. Decline is free; departure ends future offers while retaining her identity and earned property.

remainder_home.invitation.value: I transferred one actual kit, one log and two native coins to Neri's separate stock and purse under her one-stay terms. This is a supplied invitation, not an immediate occupant or finished service. Her own controller must still accept with the completed vacant room, current willingness and living supported body. The supplies are hers; meeting or rendering cannot refill them.

remainder_home.resident_report.value: I met Neri at the real Shack room. Arrival, occupancy, her funded work and collection are separate commitments. Her completed public work is available through its own known collection control; this meeting grants no stock, occupation or wage.

remainder_home.collected.value: Neri transferred the one actual Prepared survey kit produced by her completed paid service. Her returned tool kit, unspent coin, body and previous work remain hers. This kit supports the existing native field preparation, packing, orders and trade; collection cannot repeat.

world.completion.life.entry.value: You chose to connect the existing field, home and association work. People retain their own property, consent and received knowledge. Repair, measurement, learning, crop work and ordinary work remain separate choices; no supplies or past deeds were granted.

remainder.offers.supply.report.value: Ressa owns one loaded-bank job that needs a Prepared survey kit and the association’s one four-coin supply purse. Accept and deliver before her displayed local deadline, or decline freely. No report refresh creates another purse.

feature_society.meeting.value: Hessa keeps a household; Orr repairs locally; Vale is considering bounded teaching. Each has their own means and may refuse. Meeting them accepted no work.

artifact_collection.offer.value: Vela has one empty frame, one amber prism, one blue prism and one fine pin. She offers the frame for three coins and amber prism for four; one real log earns her blue prism. A loose piece has a function before the collection is complete.

world.completion.lens.terms.value: Vela offers her actual loose amber prism through the existing four-coin purchase, a one-coin owner-operated current sample check, or one consenting thirty-supported-minute loan for a separate refundable four-coin deposit. Borrowing grants use and an exact return duty, never ownership. A returned loan refunds that deposit once; a late return closes only her new voluntary lens service.

exchange.meeting.value: Iona visits from a route workshop. A damp blank bends under her clamp. She offers two wooden coins for one sound fitted seal, but asking accepts no order. She can wait ten played minutes before funding her own work.

exchange.declined.value: You declined this order. Iona will use her own stock and purse; no agreement was made.

exchange.return.value: Iona reports that she funded the fitting herself from her purse and stock. No payment or template gift is owed to you; ordinary work and paid instruction remain available.

exchange.pattern.value: Iona taught the template’s counted fittings for two kits after a paid sale. The tool is now yours; this does not grant Tamsin’s practiced control.

exchange.lens_lead.value: Iona points out the paired viewing instrument beside the Village workshop. A visitor beyond its screen sometimes writes back. Looking through it is a separate choice.

glasshouse.main.glasshouse.lead.value: Iona knows a folded-glass doorway used by a caretaker and visiting artisans. A lead is not permission or passage.

glasshouse.main.glasshouse.door.value: You paid for one opening of the folded doorway. The same interior remains when its route is closed.

glasshouse.main.glasshouse.entered.value: You carried your own body and belongings into the Folded Glasshouse. The doorway remains available for return.

glasshouse.main.glasshouse.returned.value: You returned with the same carried inventory. Joss, the bench, stored supplies and prior work remain in the Glasshouse.

lore.warning.sample.value: Completed an actual local notch/shelf sample using my counted kit and effort. The recorded drain state and observation time support a current warning; the sample says nothing certain about future weather.

lore.warning.terms.value: This distinct rain window lasts twenty supported played minutes. Deliver an attributed warning, fund a willing check, inspect yourself, clear the notch or continue ordinary work. Ressa’s old request, purse, kit need and detour provision keep their meanings. Any trial load must be a newly transferred sound stave; Ressa’s independent response finishes before its admission.

world.completion.lens.measurement.value: Performed a four-minute outdoor examination of the current notch sample using Vela’s owner-operated prism. Vela spent her own stamina and earned the one-coin fee; the same prism returned once. The observed width and alignment concern this sample only, not hidden poison, another source or future weather.

world.completion.learning.terms.value: Two native coins pay Eda only when the five-minute lesson completes. The learner holds and returns one compatible offcut and spends one own stamina; Eda spends one own stamina and keeps her Grain matching source. You may learn personally, fund a willing Neri, or keep ordinary log lining. Neri must finish and settle her old service first; sponsorship spends her own remaining attention, two two-minute trips, lesson effort and separate strip effort. It supplies no refill. A later two-minute job consumes one compatible offcut and one own stamina for one measured strip. Neri owns her actual product until she separately hands it over.

world.completion.learning.procedure.value: Completed Eda’s paid five-minute datum demonstration with one actual compatible offcut held and returned. I spent my own stamina; Eda spent hers and retained her own Grain matching source. I learned only the datum procedure. Its exact teacher/source/sample causes are retained separately; it grants no body, mana, stock or exclusive specialization.

world.completion.learning.made.value: Consumed one actual compatible offcut and my own stamina over two played minutes to fit one measured drain strip. Its frozen current sample cause is retained with this actual production. The strip is physical stock; it can supply the compatible notch or cover once.

world.completion.life.measured_line.value: Your actually taught and made measured strip became the inspected notch lining. One stamina and two supported minutes were spent; your held kit returned once. This changed the current drain before the single rain endpoint, without granting Eda's body, method or energy to you.

world.completion.learning.sponsor_offer.value: Offered one actual compatible offcut and two separate instruction coins. Neri decides whether her own remaining attention, four stamina and permitted trips support the lesson and separate strip work. A refusal preserves her old room, tool, wages and first service; only this unchanged new escrow can be withdrawn.

world.completion.learning.account.value: Met the actual Neri and heard her current answer, travel, instruction, product and handover account. This report supplies no hidden purse, stock, source or completed work.

world.completion.learning.collected.value: Neri separately handed over her actual produced measured drain strip. Its exact maker and frozen sample causes were retained. Her datum procedure, body, wages and room remain hers.

remainder.consequences.plot.terms.value: Nell opens one permitted herb bed beside the Village field association. Her association’s saved planting allocation contains one actual seed packet; buy it for two native coins, then spend one coin for water, two stamina and three played minutes planting it. No packet or crop is free from reading this report. Four further supported local played minutes bring an authored inspection of this bed: an observed cold draft then gives six minutes to cover with one log and two stamina over two minutes, harvest early for three Cooking herbs, or leave a one-herb salvage. Covered work yields five herbs once. This is an original local draft, with no claim about the world’s season or offscreen weather.

remainder.consequences.plot.purchase.value: Two actual native coins entered Nell’s purse, and her association’s one counted seed packet moved into your inventory. This purchase creates no herbs or replenished seed supply.

remainder.consequences.plot.planting.value: Your actual packet was planted in the permitted association bed over three played minutes. Nell received one coin for the bed’s measured water; your two stamina were spent. One finite crop now exists. The later local inspection can expose the authored cold draft only while this bed and its supported contact remain actual.

remainder.consequences.plot.warning.value: At this actual planted Village bed, Nell shows you a cold draft through the hedge. This explicitly authored local trigger creates one six-minute supported played-time response window. Covering consumes a real log and two stamina over two minutes for five Cooking herbs; early harvest gives three; deliberate neglect or timeout gives one. All paths end this same crop once. No global season or universal crop death is inferred.

remainder.consequences.plot.result.value: You consumed one separately made Measured drain strip to fit the narrow draft opening on Nell's same warned herb bed using the current measured datum, one stamina and two supported played minutes. This original local fit uses one prepared timber piece rather than two offcuts; it is not a universal material bonus. The strip cannot line the drain too, and no second crop or seed packet is created.

feature_objects.opening.value: Eda says a swollen joint drips onto her drying shelf. She offers a two-coin refundable knife deposit or a six-coin purchase. Bracing needs ordinary sound wood; an offered demonstration may reveal a more exact fitting method.

feature_objects.joint.value: Firsthand joint inspection: the cross-grain swollen stave leaks onto the one Village drying shelf. An ordinary brace can hold it clear while it still seeps; a matching sound-grain insert can seal this particular joint.

missed.shower.value: The shower passed; the craftsman dried his bench. No missed reward is owed.

feature_objects.purchase.value: You paid Eda six native coins for one actual sharp fitting knife from her finite stock. The tool is yours; the money is now hers.

audit_remainder.terms.value: You deliberately opened the additional local project and commission choices. Each invitation, construction, lesson, stocked offer, preparation and challenge still needs its own current terms, means and commitment. This reading grants no person, material, power, payment or obligation.

remainder_home.terms.value: Eda permits one timber rain cover over the outer measuring strip of her real Village fitting-bench site. Two supplied logs, two coins, two stamina and five played minutes build it. The cover permits only the newly offered offcut-trimming job during actual rain; the old dry rack, shelf, recipes and regional weather keep their existing rules. Your own completed cutting and drying observations can support paid measuring research. One separate specialization requires actual recovered conditioning and an ordinary loaded-frame trial.

remainder_home.trim.value: One real Rough wood log was divided into one Wet repair stave and two Green repair offcuts. Your owned sharp fitting knife became its dulled variant and stayed yours. These three counted green pieces account for the timber; none is sound or dry yet. The reusable measuring jig was not supplied.

remainder_home.dry_offcuts.value: Two actual Green repair offcuts from the disclosed local trimming stock dried into two Compatible repair offcuts over six played minutes. No piece was duplicated and no jig or fitting knowledge was awarded.

remainder_home.room_terms.value: I authorize one guest room inside my actually assembled, player-owned field-workshop site at the native Shack. Two staged phases consume two logs, four construction coins, seven played minutes and three stamina; a counted kit is held and returned in finishing. Only the finished room grants one residence claim. A later one-time willing invitation requires a separate real kit, log and two-coin starter purse. No automatic rent, food drain or supply refill is created.

remainder_home.room_frame.value: One supplied Rough wood log and two paid construction coins became the guest-room frame inside your earned Shack field-workshop site. Four played minutes and one stamina were spent. A frame grants no residence slot or resident.

remainder_home.room_finished.value: The second real log and two construction coins finished one guest room at your earned Shack field workshop. Your counted kit was returned once. The completed room grants exactly one unoccupied residence claim; it grants no person, wood, kit, wage or service. No dismantling action is offered, and occupancy must end before any later removal design.

remainder_home.resident_terms.value: Neri is an independent willing local kit binder with her own body, learned operation and finite attention. Meeting her supplies no tool, wage, residence or result. Invite supplies one actual kit, one log and two native coins to her own stock/purse. She independently accepts supported terms, occupies the one room and performs at most one material service. One coin pays her fittings expense; one remains hers. One produced kit may be collected after her actual job. Decline is free; departure ends future offers while retaining her identity and earned property.

remainder_home.invitation.value: I transferred one actual kit, one log and two native coins to Neri's separate stock and purse under her one-stay terms. This is a supplied invitation, not an immediate occupant or finished service. Her own controller must still accept with the completed vacant room, current willingness and living supported body. The supplies are hers; meeting or rendering cannot refill them.

remainder_home.resident_report.value: I met Neri at the real Shack room. Arrival, occupancy, her funded work and collection are separate commitments. Her completed public work is available through its own known collection control; this meeting grants no stock, occupation or wage.

remainder_home.collected.value: Neri transferred the one actual Prepared survey kit produced by her completed paid service. Her returned tool kit, unspent coin, body and previous work remain hers. This kit supports the existing native field preparation, packing, orders and trade; collection cannot repeat.

world.completion.life.entry.value: You chose to connect the existing field, home and association work. People retain their own property, consent and received knowledge. Repair, measurement, learning, crop work and ordinary work remain separate choices; no supplies or past deeds were granted.

remainder.offers.supply.report.value: Ressa owns one loaded-bank job that needs a Prepared survey kit and the association’s one four-coin supply purse. Accept and deliver before her displayed local deadline, or decline freely. No report refresh creates another purse.

feature_society.meeting.value: Hessa keeps a household; Orr repairs locally; Vale is considering bounded teaching. Each has their own means and may refuse. Meeting them accepted no work.

artifact_collection.offer.value: Vela has one empty frame, one amber prism, one blue prism and one fine pin. She offers the frame for three coins and amber prism for four; one real log earns her blue prism. A loose piece has a function before the collection is complete.

world.completion.lens.terms.value: Vela offers her actual loose amber prism through the existing four-coin purchase, a one-coin owner-operated current sample check, or one consenting thirty-supported-minute loan for a separate refundable four-coin deposit. Borrowing grants use and an exact return duty, never ownership. A returned loan refunds that deposit once; a late return closes only her new voluntary lens service.

exchange.meeting.value: Iona visits from a route workshop. A damp blank bends under her clamp. She offers two wooden coins for one sound fitted seal, but asking accepts no order. She can wait ten played minutes before funding her own work.

exchange.declined.value: You declined this order. Iona will use her own stock and purse; no agreement was made.

exchange.return.value: Iona reports that she funded the fitting herself from her purse and stock. No payment or template gift is owed to you; ordinary work and paid instruction remain available.

exchange.pattern.value: Iona taught the template’s counted fittings for two kits after a paid sale. The tool is now yours; this does not grant Tamsin’s practiced control.

exchange.lens_lead.value: Iona points out the paired viewing instrument beside the Village workshop. A visitor beyond its screen sometimes writes back. Looking through it is a separate choice.

glasshouse.main.glasshouse.lead.value: Iona knows a folded-glass doorway used by a caretaker and visiting artisans. A lead is not permission or passage.

glasshouse.main.glasshouse.door.value: You paid for one opening of the folded doorway. The same interior remains when its route is closed.

glasshouse.main.glasshouse.entered.value: You carried your own body and belongings into the Folded Glasshouse. The doorway remains available for return.

glasshouse.main.glasshouse.returned.value: You returned with the same carried inventory. Joss, the bench, stored supplies and prior work remain in the Glasshouse.

lore.warning.sample.value: Completed an actual local notch/shelf sample using my counted kit and effort. The recorded drain state and observation time support a current warning; the sample says nothing certain about future weather.

lore.warning.terms.value: This distinct rain window lasts twenty supported played minutes. Deliver an attributed warning, fund a willing check, inspect yourself, clear the notch or continue ordinary work. Ressa’s old request, purse, kit need and detour provision keep their meanings. Any trial load must be a newly transferred sound stave; Ressa’s independent response finishes before its admission.

world.completion.lens.measurement.value: Performed a four-minute outdoor examination of the current notch sample using Vela’s owner-operated prism. Vela spent her own stamina and earned the one-coin fee; the same prism returned once. The observed width and alignment concern this sample only, not hidden poison, another source or future weather.

world.completion.learning.terms.value: Two native coins pay Eda only when the five-minute lesson completes. The learner holds and returns one compatible offcut and spends one own stamina; Eda spends one own stamina and keeps her Grain matching source. You may learn personally, fund a willing Neri, or keep ordinary log lining. Neri must finish and settle her old service first; sponsorship spends her own remaining attention, two two-minute trips, lesson effort and separate strip effort. It supplies no refill. A later two-minute job consumes one compatible offcut and one own stamina for one measured strip. Neri owns her actual product until she separately hands it over.

world.completion.learning.procedure.value: Completed Eda’s paid five-minute datum demonstration with one actual compatible offcut held and returned. I spent my own stamina; Eda spent hers and retained her own Grain matching source. I learned only the datum procedure. Its exact teacher/source/sample causes are retained separately; it grants no body, mana, stock or exclusive specialization.

world.completion.learning.made.value: Consumed one actual compatible offcut and my own stamina over two played minutes to fit one measured drain strip. Its frozen current sample cause is retained with this actual production. The strip is physical stock; it can supply the compatible notch or cover once.

world.completion.life.measured_line.value: Your actually taught and made measured strip became the inspected notch lining. One stamina and two supported minutes were spent; your held kit returned once. This changed the current drain before the single rain endpoint, without granting Eda's body, method or energy to you.

world.completion.learning.sponsor_offer.value: Offered one actual compatible offcut and two separate instruction coins. Neri decides whether her own remaining attention, four stamina and permitted trips support the lesson and separate strip work. A refusal preserves her old room, tool, wages and first service; only this unchanged new escrow can be withdrawn.

world.completion.learning.account.value: Met the actual Neri and heard her current answer, travel, instruction, product and handover account. This report supplies no hidden purse, stock, source or completed work.

world.completion.learning.collected.value: Neri separately handed over her actual produced measured drain strip. Its exact maker and frozen sample causes were retained. Her datum procedure, body, wages and room remain hers.

remainder.consequences.plot.terms.value: Nell opens one permitted herb bed beside the Village field association. Her association’s saved planting allocation contains one actual seed packet; buy it for two native coins, then spend one coin for water, two stamina and three played minutes planting it. No packet or crop is free from reading this report. Four further supported local played minutes bring an authored inspection of this bed: an observed cold draft then gives six minutes to cover with one log and two stamina over two minutes, harvest early for three Cooking herbs, or leave a one-herb salvage. Covered work yields five herbs once. This is an original local draft, with no claim about the world’s season or offscreen weather.

remainder.consequences.plot.purchase.value: Two actual native coins entered Nell’s purse, and her association’s one counted seed packet moved into your inventory. This purchase creates no herbs or replenished seed supply.

remainder.consequences.plot.planting.value: Your actual packet was planted in the permitted association bed over three played minutes. Nell received one coin for the bed’s measured water; your two stamina were spent. One finite crop now exists. The later local inspection can expose the authored cold draft only while this bed and its supported contact remain actual.

remainder.consequences.plot.warning.value: At this actual planted Village bed, Nell shows you a cold draft through the hedge. This explicitly authored local trigger creates one six-minute supported played-time response window. Covering consumes a real log and two stamina over two minutes for five Cooking herbs; early harvest gives three; deliberate neglect or timeout gives one. All paths end this same crop once. No global season or universal crop death is inferred.

remainder.consequences.plot.result.value: You consumed one separately made Measured drain strip to fit the narrow draft opening on Nell's same warned herb bed using the current measured datum, one stamina and two supported played minutes. The real strip remains in that cover. Its single final harvest added five real Cooking herbs to your native inventory. This original local fit uses one prepared timber piece rather than two offcuts; it is not a universal material bonus. The strip cannot line the drain too, and no second crop or seed packet is created.

world.completion.materials.cover.value: You consumed one separately made Measured drain strip to fit the narrow draft opening on Nell's same warned herb bed using the current measured datum, one stamina and two supported played minutes. The real strip remains in that cover. Its single final harvest added five real Cooking herbs to your native inventory. This original local fit uses one prepared timber piece rather than two offcuts; it is not a universal material bonus. The strip cannot line the drain too, and no second crop or seed packet is created.

nested.chart.value: A voluntary original side entry leads to the qualified Paradise service district. Approval carries the same living body and owned cargo. Employee work and contractor missions are separate approvals. Credits stay separate from wooden coins and XP; this entry grants no Hunter status, resurrection or copied rights.

nested.enrollment.value: Approved a voluntary resident side entry. Finite district and destination owners were created once. No mission, wage, source growth or new body was awarded.

nested.passage.value: Arrived in the service district in the same living native body with complete owned/equipped cargo. Local clocks resume; prior owners and histories remain.

nested.hub.life.value: Lin earns service wages and can use the workbench and subsidized rest. Mara issues optional contracts. Oren teaches at the workroom. Each keeps finite personal funds and supplies; travel alone accepts no work.

nested.role.employee.value: Employee approval grants funded local shifts, staff supply access and subsidized rest. It does not confer contractor mission authority or a Hunter brand. You may seek contractor approval later between commitments.

nested.shift.value: Used Lin’s counted log to make Lin a kit. Four reserved credits paid your purse, alongside ordinary Crafting practice. Finite stock and wages do not refill on return.

remainder_home.permission.value: I permit the traveler to build one cover on my outer measuring strip and do the disclosed new trimming and measuring work here. My existing shelf, recipes, stock and ownership remain separate. Cover payment is two coins only at actual completion.

world.completion.learning.taught_player.value: I completed this paid datum lesson with the actual learner and held demonstration offcut. Two coins entered my own purse. My own source and body stayed mine.

world.completion.learning.taught_neri.value: I completed this paid datum lesson with the actual learner and held demonstration offcut. Two coins entered my own purse. My own source and body stayed mine.

remainder_home.resident_method.value: I learned ordinary kit binding through my earlier local work. I arrive with my own living two-handed body and finite attention, but no timber, kit or purse. I will choose one funded stay and one supported binding job, retain my own tool and unspent wage, and may leave after reserved work ends.

remainder_home.acceptance.value: I choose the one funded stay in the actual completed vacant Shack room. Its unique residence claim now records my occupancy. I own the supplied kit, log and purse. I will decide on my own one supported binding service; arrival produces no material.

remainder_home.service.value: I spent my supplied log, one actual purse coin for fittings, two of my stamina, one attention and five played minutes to make one new Prepared survey kit. My counted tool kit returned exactly once and stays mine. I retain my remaining coin. The new product belongs to me until the disclosed collection transfer; no second service is promised.

world.completion.learning.offer.value: Received one new actual compatible offcut and two separately held lesson coins. I may accept or decline on my own present means. This offer does not replenish my attention or stamina.

world.completion.learning.accept.value: I consented to one funded datum lesson and separate owned strip work after checking my own attention, four stamina, unchanged supplied stock and Eda’s actual permitted site/source. The trips, demonstration and production still need to happen.

world.completion.learning.arrived.value: Spent my own stamina and two played minutes reaching Eda’s actual Village bench. My body and stock moved together; the traveler need not be my controller.

world.completion.learning.procedure.value: Completed Eda’s paid five-minute datum demonstration with one actual compatible offcut held and returned. I spent my own stamina; Eda spent hers and retained her own Grain matching source. I learned only the datum procedure. Its exact teacher/source/sample causes are retained separately; it grants no body, mana, stock or exclusive specialization.

world.completion.learning.made.value: Consumed the actual supplied compatible offcut and my own stamina over two played minutes to fit one measured drain strip. It is my physical product until the separate agreed handover. No traveler source or stock was granted.

world.completion.learning.returned.value: Spent my own stamina and two played minutes returning to my retained room after the new work ended or was released. No stock, attention or lesson was reset.

remainder.offers.supply.source.value: The association allocated its one finite four-coin local-supply purse to my one loaded-bank job.

remainder.offers.supply.expiry.value: The local deadline passed. I recovered any reserved four coins and kept the unmet need; I will spend my one detour effort on the longer route. No unpaid traveler promise is invented.

remainder.offers.supply.detour.value: Spent my one detour-effort provision and one stamina over two minutes to check the longer route. The kit need remains unmet; no new payout or stock appeared.

exchange.self_fit.value: I paid three coins and used my own sound blank, kit and stamina to fit my parcel.

feature_objects.purchase.value: You paid Eda six native coins for one actual sharp fitting knife from her finite stock. The tool is yours; the money is now hers.

audit_remainder.terms.value: You deliberately opened the additional local project and commission choices. Each invitation, construction, lesson, stocked offer, preparation and challenge still needs its own current terms, means and commitment. This reading grants no person, material, power, payment or obligation.

remainder_home.terms.value: Eda permits one timber rain cover over the outer measuring strip of her real Village fitting-bench site. Two supplied logs, two coins, two stamina and five played minutes build it. The cover permits only the newly offered offcut-trimming job during actual rain; the old dry rack, shelf, recipes and regional weather keep their existing rules. Your own completed cutting and drying observations can support paid measuring research. One separate specialization requires actual recovered conditioning and an ordinary loaded-frame trial.

remainder_home.trim.value: One real Rough wood log was divided into one Wet repair stave and two Green repair offcuts. Your owned sharp fitting knife became its dulled variant and stayed yours. These three counted green pieces account for the timber; none is sound or dry yet. The reusable measuring jig was not supplied.

remainder_home.dry_offcuts.value: Two actual Green repair offcuts from the disclosed local trimming stock dried into two Compatible repair offcuts over six played minutes. No piece was duplicated and no jig or fitting knowledge was awarded.

remainder_home.room_terms.value: I authorize one guest room inside my actually assembled, player-owned field-workshop site at the native Shack. Two staged phases consume two logs, four construction coins, seven played minutes and three stamina; a counted kit is held and returned in finishing. Only the finished room grants one residence claim. A later one-time willing invitation requires a separate real kit, log and two-coin starter purse. No automatic rent, food drain or supply refill is created.

remainder_home.room_frame.value: One supplied Rough wood log and two paid construction coins became the guest-room frame inside your earned Shack field-workshop site. Four played minutes and one stamina were spent. A frame grants no residence slot or resident.

remainder_home.room_finished.value: The second real log and two construction coins finished one guest room at your earned Shack field workshop. Your counted kit was returned once. The completed room grants exactly one unoccupied residence claim; it grants no person, wood, kit, wage or service. No dismantling action is offered, and occupancy must end before any later removal design.

remainder_home.resident_terms.value: Neri is an independent willing local kit binder with her own body, learned operation and finite attention. Meeting her supplies no tool, wage, residence or result. Invite supplies one actual kit, one log and two native coins to her own stock/purse. She independently accepts supported terms, occupies the one room and performs at most one material service. One coin pays her fittings expense; one remains hers. One produced kit may be collected after her actual job. Decline is free; departure ends future offers while retaining her identity and earned property.

She independently accepts supported terms, occupies the one room and performs at most one material service. One coin pays her fittings expense; one remains hers. One produced kit may be collected after her actual job. Decline is free; departure ends future offers while retaining her identity and earned property.

remainder_home.invitation.value: I transferred one actual kit, one log and two native coins to Neri's separate stock and purse under her one-stay terms. This is a supplied invitation, not an immediate occupant or finished service. Her own controller must still accept with the completed vacant room, current willingness and living supported body. The supplies are hers; meeting or rendering cannot refill them.

remainder_home.resident_report.value: I met Neri at the real Shack room. Arrival, occupancy, her funded work and collection are separate commitments. Her completed public work is available through its own known collection control; this meeting grants no stock, occupation or wage.

remainder_home.collected.value: Neri transferred the one actual Prepared survey kit produced by her completed paid service. Her returned tool kit, unspent coin, body and previous work remain hers. This kit supports the existing native field preparation, packing, orders and trade; collection cannot repeat.

world.completion.life.entry.value: You chose to connect the existing field, home and association work. People retain their own property, consent and received knowledge. Repair, measurement, learning, crop work and ordinary work remain separate choices; no supplies or past deeds were granted.

remainder.offers.supply.report.value: Ressa owns one loaded-bank job that needs a Prepared survey kit and the association’s one four-coin supply purse. Accept and deliver before her displayed local deadline, or decline freely. No report refresh creates another purse.

feature_society.meeting.value: Hessa keeps a household; Orr repairs locally; Vale is considering bounded teaching. Each has their own means and may refuse. Meeting them accepted no work.

artifact_collection.offer.value: Vela has one empty frame, one amber prism, one blue prism and one fine pin. She offers the frame for three coins and amber prism for four; one real log earns her blue prism. A loose piece has a function before the collection is complete.

world.completion.lens.terms.value: Vela offers her actual loose amber prism through the existing four-coin purchase, a one-coin owner-operated current sample check, or one consenting thirty-supported-minute loan for a separate refundable four-coin deposit. Borrowing grants use and an exact return duty, never ownership. A returned loan refunds that deposit once; a late return closes only her new voluntary lens service.

exchange.meeting.value: Iona visits from a route workshop. A damp blank bends under her clamp. She offers two wooden coins for one sound fitted seal, but asking accepts no order. She can wait ten played minutes before funding her own work.

exchange.declined.value: You declined this order. Iona will use her own stock and purse; no agreement was made.

exchange.return.value: Iona reports that she funded the fitting herself from her purse and stock. No payment or template gift is owed to you; ordinary work and paid instruction remain available.

exchange.pattern.value: Iona taught the template’s counted fittings for two kits after a paid sale. The tool is now yours; this does not grant Tamsin’s practiced control.

exchange.lens_lead.value: Iona points out the paired viewing instrument beside the Village workshop. A visitor beyond its screen sometimes writes back. Looking through it is a separate choice.

glasshouse.main.glasshouse.lead.value: Iona knows a folded-glass doorway used by a caretaker and visiting artisans. A lead is not permission or passage.

glasshouse.main.glasshouse.door.value: You paid for one opening of the folded doorway. The same interior remains when its route is closed.

glasshouse.main.glasshouse.entered.value: You carried your own body and belongings into the Folded Glasshouse. The doorway remains available for return.

glasshouse.main.glasshouse.returned.value: You returned with the same carried inventory. Joss, the bench, stored supplies and prior work remain in the Glasshouse.

lore.warning.sample.value: Completed an actual local notch/shelf sample using my counted kit and effort. The recorded drain state and observation time support a current warning; the sample says nothing certain about future weather.

lore.warning.terms.value: This distinct rain window lasts twenty supported played minutes. Deliver an attributed warning, fund a willing check, inspect yourself, clear the notch or continue ordinary work. Ressa’s old request, purse, kit need and detour provision keep their meanings. Any trial load must be a newly transferred sound stave; Ressa’s independent response finishes before its admission.

world.completion.lens.measurement.value: Performed a four-minute outdoor examination of the current notch sample using Vela’s owner-operated prism. Vela spent her own stamina and earned the one-coin fee; the same prism returned once. The observed width and alignment concern this sample only, not hidden poison, another source or future weather.

world.completion.learning.terms.value: Two native coins pay Eda only when the five-minute lesson completes. The learner holds and returns one compatible offcut and spends one own stamina; Eda spends one own stamina and keeps her Grain matching source. You may learn personally, fund a willing Neri, or keep ordinary log lining. Neri must finish and settle her old service first; sponsorship spends her own remaining attention, two two-minute trips, lesson effort and separate strip effort. It supplies no refill. A later two-minute job consumes one compatible offcut and one own stamina for one measured strip. Neri owns her actual product until she separately hands it over.

world.completion.learning.procedure.value: Completed Eda’s paid five-minute datum demonstration with one actual compatible offcut held and returned. I spent my own stamina; Eda spent hers and retained her own Grain matching source. I learned only the datum procedure. Its exact teacher/source/sample causes are retained separately; it grants no body, mana, stock or exclusive specialization.

world.completion.learning.made.value: Consumed one actual compatible offcut and my own stamina over two played minutes to fit one measured drain strip. Its frozen current sample cause is retained with this actual production. The strip is physical stock; it can supply the compatible notch or cover once.

world.completion.life.measured_line.value: Your actually taught and made measured strip became the inspected notch lining. One stamina and two supported minutes were spent; your held kit returned once. This changed the current drain before the single rain endpoint, without granting Eda's body, method or energy to you.

world.completion.learning.sponsor_offer.value: Offered one actual compatible offcut and two separate instruction coins. Neri decides whether her own remaining attention, four stamina and permitted trips support the lesson and separate strip work. world.completion.learning.collected.value: Neri separately handed over her actual produced measured drain strip. Its exact maker and frozen sample causes were retained. Her datum procedure, body, wages and room remain hers.

remainder.consequences.plot.terms.value: Nell opens one permitted herb bed beside the Village field association. Her association’s saved planting allocation contains one actual seed packet; buy it for two native coins, then spend one coin for water, two stamina and three played minutes planting it. No packet or crop is free from reading this report. Four further supported local played minutes bring an authored inspection of this bed: an observed cold draft then gives six minutes to cover with one log and two stamina over two minutes, harvest early for three Cooking herbs, or leave a one-herb salvage. Covered work yields five herbs once. This is an original local draft, with no claim about the world’s season or offscreen weather.

remainder.consequences.plot.purchase.value: Two actual native coins entered Nell’s purse, and her association’s one counted seed packet moved into your inventory. This purchase creates no herbs or replenished seed supply.

No global season or universal crop death is inferred.
